Baron Virril

Biography

Baron Virril commands the Canian holdouts on Jigran against Firez’s Khadaganian forces. Proud of his family, he dislikes asking for aid even after losing Dar-Ulgorn. Kir’s arrival, the fight against the undead and the recruitment of powerful allies give his army a chance to attack Firez’s stronghold. He imagines a restored, prosperous Jigran ruled by his descendants. [1, 2, 3]
